scenario: LUNI.8.7.1 — a `::<unit>` conversion cast carries the target unit's dimension through the dim checks. `s.raw::celsius` tags the temperature dim on `s.raw` (a Float slot) so comparing against `30_celsius` succeeds via the same-dim Compare admit (LUNI.8.1).
rules_ds:
unit celsius: temperature = x + 273.15

schema Sensor scope logical:
    raw: Float key

rule warm:
    Sensor s where s.raw::celsius > 30_celsius
->
    log info "warm via cast"
